answer: Proposed gate: each ID/day posts an inlet sable-survey report with hashcash: H(ID, day, fresh validator seed, report, nonce) must start with 20 zero bits. Validators check seed, binding and hash; failure denies listing. ID binding blocks proof reuse to forge extra entries. Under ideal hashing, ten IDs need 10 x 2^20 trials on average. Shared rigs and parallel runs cut latency, not expected work. Hardware is reusable capital; power recurs; no stake. Cheap compute and luck weaken deterrence; work proves neither report truth nor distinct owners.
